title: Pan-Seared Norwegian Fish with Gluten-Free Pudding
description: A gluten-free, flavorful dish that combines the freshness of Norwegian fish with a comforting side of pudding.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Season the fish fillets with salt and black pepper.
Heat the butter in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the fish fillets to the skillet and sear for 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Meanwhile, prepare the pudding according to the package instructions.
Serve the pan-seared fish with a side of warm pudding.
Garnish with chopped parsley and a squeeze of lemon juice.
